visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an animated graphic on a light blue background featuring the orange logo 'SAUSCHESTRA'. Several plush dachshund dogs in orange, brown, and black colors are depicted holding various musical instruments like a keyboard, xylophone, and flute. White variety text overlays and music note symbols float around the characters. (2) A man with short black hair wearing a blue and white striped shirt sits indoors at a rustic wooden table. He is shown unboxing an orange package, tearing into a silver foil pouch with high focus and smiling as he reveals a brown dachshund plush holding a yellow triangle-shaped xylophone. (3) The setting shifts to a modern living room with a white sofa and abstract art on the wall. The man holds an orange box and shakes it near his ear while looking directly at the camera with an inquisitive expression, then points to specific character designs printed on the side of the box. (4) He continues unboxing on the sofa, holding a silver bag up. He jokingly covers his eyes with his hands as another person's hand reaches into the frame to pull out a white dachshund plush toy, creating a moment of suspense and surprise. (5) In a close-up shot, the man holds up a character card and then reveals a rare, larger plush dachshund that appears to be carrying a smaller white dog. His facial expressions are highly animated, showing wide-eyed excitement and joy. (6) A series of quick cuts shows the man holding multiple dachshund plushies on his fingers and hand. The scene transitions to an outdoor view of a cafe named 'Benkoff' with a dog logo, and finally back to the man posing with his full collection of plushies against a wooden wall background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a bright, high-tempo electronic pop track featuring a consistent drum machine beat. A male voice enters immediately, speaking with high arousal and a very fast speech rate, delivering a welcoming introduction with a rising pitch contour that signals excitement. (2) A sharp, distinct rustling sound of a metallic silver bag being torn open punctuates the narration. The BGM remains energetic at approximately 124 BPM. The male speaker's intensity increases as he reacts to the first item found, his tone becoming playful and celebratory. (3) A percussive rattling sound of small objects hitting the inside of a cardboard box is heard several times as the host shakes the blind box. The narration continues with high articulation clarity, maintaining a professional yet highly animated social media persona. (4) More intense plastic crinkling sounds occur as another bag is opened. A secondary female voice is heard laughing softly and saying 'Good!' in the background, which adds to the spontaneous, collaborative unboxing atmosphere. (5) As a rare hidden version character is revealed, the male voice reaches a peak arousal level with a short shout of surprise and laughter. The BGM swells slightly to match the emotional buildup of the discovery. (6) The final phase features a continuous fast-paced narration with a persuasive call-to-action tone. Short digital 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects are used to highlight visual transitions and text appearing on the screen until the audio fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a high-energy unboxing and promotional piece for a limited-edition dachshund-themed blind box series called 'Sauschestra' from Thailand. The creator uses the thrill of unboxing, specifically the discovery of a 'hidden version' plush, to generate excitement and drive viewers toward a group buy link for the products.
